Card Q&A.a: This card's [When Attacking] effect can play a blue level 3 Digimon card, or it can play a Tamer card.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be played using this card's [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: [When Attacking] You may play 1 blue level 3 Digimon card or 1 Tamer card from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
